Make the unittests for ecj work on windows
Couple more tests for val
Updated changelog with the recent changes.
'val' is no longer legal in basic for loops now. Fixes issue #346
ecj tests and eclipse tests are now effectively doing the same thing, except the ecj tests are written in a slightly more close-to-reality way, and do work for 'val'. eclipse test aspect removed.

More test files, test files updated to be valid java, and ecj test now goes through the complete compile process. This means val and @Delegate testing is now enabled.

TODO: Update -eclipse tests.
Update to error messages of @Log annotations.
Bumped copyright years on recently (in 2012) changed sources.
No more autobox/type coercion issues with @Getter(lazy=true) and primitive types. (Issue #345).
'val' now works for member types whose outers have generics. (issue #343)
Smart ATHROW reducer removed because that can at least in theory go wrong, and saving one byte isn't relevant, as far as I know. This is simpler, too :)
whitespace only
Updated copyright notice in command line tool help, made debug tool=true subapps not show up in the list of available commands.

further fixes to the build script. I think it's good now....

Okay, now the build should be truly fixed again... at least, if  you're running on a 1.6 VM.

The test run now has more fine-grained dependency control, in preparation for running tests against multiple different platform versions (javac1.6, old eclipse, new eclipse, etc)
